artifacts.summary: GAP 1 (missing conclusion report block) is already closed by an unrelated prior commit, verification only; GAP 2 (roadmap-generator caller split) is real, with a third previously-unnoticed stale-header finding, plus concrete edit recommendations for roadmap-update.md and conclusion-stage.md.

memory_candidates.content: When a task description cites a gap found during a specific past run/date (e.g. 'found during an /orchestrate run on 2026-10-08'), check `git log` on the named target file(s) for commits landed on or after that date before assuming the gap still exists — an unrelated task's later phase may have already closed it. In this case the task's GAP 1 (a missing report block in a template file) had already been fixed by a different task's phase commit the same day the gap was discovered, before this research dispatch ran. A quick `git log --oneline -p -- <file>` plus a source-vs-deployed diff caught this and avoided duplicate authorship.
